engine.name: equity-diagnostic-engine
engine.note: Deterministic: no network, no LLM. Diagnoses financials only; strategy and management judgement stay with the analyst.

notes: Historical years use today's risk-free rate (7.41%); add rf_history for year-specific rates.
Financial company: WACC not meaningful (deposits/borrowings are raw material); Ke is the hurdle rate.

root.text: Creates value: ROE 16.0% vs Ke 15.8% in FY26 -> economic profit Rs 844 cr. Economic profit was positive in 4 of 9 years; trend improving.

triggered.name: P/B well above what returns justify
triggered.text: P/B of 2.8x is 2.3x the 1.2x that sustainable ROE justifies ((ROE - g)/(Ke - g)): the market expects returns to rise.

roe.name: Return on equity
roe.equation: core PAT / average equity (share capital + reserves)
roe.meaning: Owners' core profit per rupee of shareholders' equity.

band.rationale: ROE below the cost of equity destroys value; 5pp above it is clear value creation. Ke = rf + beta x ERP (config/market.yaml).

roe.text: Return on equity: 16.0% AMBER (level amber vs band (red <= 15.8%, green >= 20.8%); trend stable +0.3pp/yr; volatile (CV 0.41))

roa.name: Return on assets
roa.meaning: Owners' core profit per rupee of total assets.

band.rationale: RBI Financial Stability Report (June 2025): scheduled commercial banks' annualised ROA 1.4% (secondary summary; June-2026 FSR figures were not retrievable). Amber zone = 1.4% +/- 20%.

roa.text: Return on assets: 2.0% GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 1.1%, green >= 1.7%); trend stable +0.1pp/yr; stable (CV 0.13))

roe_ke_spread.name: ROE - cost of equity
roe_ke_spread.equation: ROE - Ke, Ke = rf + beta x ERP
roe_ke_spread.meaning: Value created per rupee of equity for a lender/insurer.

band.rationale: Spread below zero = value destruction; above +5pp = clear value creation.

roe_ke_spread.text: ROE - cost of equity: +0.2pp AMBER (level amber vs band (red <= +0.0pp, green >= +5.0pp); trend improving +0.3pp/yr; volatile (CV 1.93))

attributable_factor.name: Attributable-profit factor
attributable_factor.meaning: Owners' share of after-tax profit: below 1 = minorities take a slice; above 1 = associate/JV income adds to it.

tax_burden.name: Tax burden
tax_burden.meaning: Share of pre-tax profit kept after tax (1 - effective tax rate).

equity_multiplier.name: Equity multiplier
equity_multiplier.meaning: Assets per rupee of equity: the leverage term in DuPont.

debt_to_equity_avg.name: Borrowings / equity (average)
debt_to_equity_avg.meaning: Debt part of the equity multiplier.

other_liab_to_equity_avg.name: Other liabilities / equity (average)
other_liab_to_equity_avg.meaning: Non-debt liabilities part of the equity multiplier.

interest_to_assets.name: Interest expended / assets
interest_to_assets.meaning: Interest paid per rupee of average assets. ROA = yield - interest + other income - opex - depreciation - tax + minority/associates.

other_income_to_assets.name: Other income / assets
other_income_to_assets.meaning: Fee and other income per rupee of average assets. ROA = yield - interest + other income - opex - depreciation - tax + minority/associates.

dep_to_assets.name: Depreciation / assets
dep_to_assets.meaning: Depreciation per rupee of average assets. ROA = yield - interest + other income - opex - depreciation - tax + minority/associates.

tax_to_assets.name: Tax / assets
tax_to_assets.meaning: Tax per rupee of average assets. ROA = yield - interest + other income - opex - depreciation - tax + minority/associates.

minority_to_assets.name: Minority & associates / assets
minority_to_assets.meaning: Associate income less minority share per rupee of average assets. ROA = yield - interest + other income - opex - depreciation - tax + minority/associates.

payout_ratio.name: Dividend payout
payout_ratio.meaning: Share of core profit paid as dividends (Screener 'Dividend Amount', declared for the year).

share_count_change.name: Share count change
share_count_change.meaning: Net issuance (dilution, +) or buyback (-) of shares, adjusted for splits and bonuses.

band.rationale: Net issuance above 3% a year is material dilution; flat or falling share count = no dilution/buybacks.

share_count_change.text: Share count change: 0.5% AMBER (level amber vs band (green <= 0.0%, red >= 3.0%); trend stable +0.1pp/yr; volatile (CV 0.42))

buyback_estimate.name: Buyback (estimate)
buyback_estimate.equation: max(0, -(Adj shares_t - Adj shares_t-1)) x (Price_t + Price_t-1)/2
buyback_estimate.meaning: Estimated rupees spent on buybacks: shares retired x average of the two year-end prices.

shareholder_yield.name: Shareholder yield
shareholder_yield.meaning: Cash returned to shareholders (dividends + estimated buybacks) as a share of year-end market value.

promoter_holding.name: Promoter holding
promoter_holding.meaning: Promoter (controlling shareholder) stake. Not in the Screener export: supply promoter_holding_pct in data/manual.

promoter_holding_change_3y.name: Promoter holding change 3y
promoter_holding_change_3y.meaning: Change in promoter stake over 3 years (selling down = negative).

band.rationale: Promoters selling more than 3pp of the company over 3 years is a signal worth explaining.

promoter_pledge.name: Promoter pledge
promoter_pledge.meaning: Share of promoter holding pledged to lenders (forced-selling risk). Manual data only.

band.rationale: Pledges above a quarter of promoter holding create forced-selling risk in a drawdown.

promoter_pledge.reason: no value for the as-of year

internal_capital_generation.name: Internal capital generation
internal_capital_generation.meaning: Growth in equity a lender can fund from retained profit alone.

growth_minus_icg.name: Asset growth - internal capital generation
growth_minus_icg.equation: (Total assets_t / Total assets_t-1 - 1) - ROE x (1 - payout)
growth_minus_icg.meaning: Balance-sheet growth beyond what retained earnings can support: must be funded by new equity or by higher leverage.

band.rationale: Balance-sheet growth 10pp+ above internal capital generation must be funded by dilution or by thinner capital.

growth_minus_icg.text: Asset growth - internal capital generation: -3.2pp GREEN (level green vs band (green <= +0.0pp, red >= +10.0pp); trend improving -0.4pp/yr; volatile (CV 2.20))

equity_to_assets.name: Equity / assets
equity_to_assets.meaning: Book capital cushion per rupee of assets (unweighted leverage; regulatory CRAR needs risk weights not in the export).

band.rationale: RBI's Basel III leverage-ratio floor is 4% (D-SIBs) / 3.5% (others) of Tier-1 to exposure; book equity below 6% of assets leaves a thin cushion, 10%+ is well capitalised.

equity_to_assets.text: Equity / assets: 12.5% GREEN (level green vs band (red <= 6.0%, green >= 10.0%); trend improving +0.5pp/yr; stable (CV 0.10))

funding_vs_equity_growth.name: Funding growth - equity growth
funding_vs_equity_growth.meaning: Deposits + borrowings growing faster than capital = rising leverage.

band.rationale: Deposits + borrowings growing 10pp a year faster than equity = rapidly rising leverage.

funding_vs_equity_growth.text: Funding growth - equity growth: -5.5pp GREEN (level green vs band (green <= +0.0pp, red >= +10.0pp); trend improving -1.1pp/yr; volatile (CV 3.88))

revenue_growth_volatility.name: Revenue growth volatility

economic_profit.name: Economic profit
economic_profit.equation: Non-financials: (ROIC - WACC) x average IC = NOPAT - WACC x average IC (defined even when IC <= 0); financials: (ROE - Ke) x average equity

pe.equation: Market cap / core PAT (current: TTM PAT when available)

pe_percentile_10y.name: P/E percentile vs own history
pe_percentile_10y.equation: (# historical FY-end P/E below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values
pe_percentile_10y.meaning: Where today's P/E sits within the company's own FY-end history (0% = cheapest ever, 100% = richest). Needs >= 5 years.

band.rationale: Bottom third of the company's own 10-year range = cheap versus itself; top third = rich versus itself.

pb.name: P/B
pb.meaning: P/B multiple. Series = FY-end values; the last value is the current multiple (export price) in a latest run.

pb_percentile_10y.name: P/B percentile vs own history
pb_percentile_10y.equation: (# historical FY-end P/B below current + 0.5 x # equal) / # historical values
pb_percentile_10y.meaning: Where today's P/B sits within the company's own FY-end history (0% = cheapest ever, 100% = richest). Needs >= 5 years.

implied_growth_pb.name: P/B-implied growth
implied_growth_pb.equation: g = (Ke x P/B - ROE) / (P/B - 1); n/m if |P/B - 1| < 0.05
implied_growth_pb.meaning: Perpetual growth implied by today's P/B for a lender/insurer (justified P/B solved for g) at its 3-year average ROE.

implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.name: P/B-implied - delivered growth
implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.equation: implied_growth_pb - BVPS CAGR 5y (PAT CAGR 5y if n/m)
implied_pb_growth_minus_delivered.meaning: Growth the market prices in versus the book-value compounding actually delivered over 5 years.

band.rationale: Same logic for lenders/insurers versus delivered book-value compounding.

justified_pb.name: Justified P/B
justified_pb.equation: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g); ROE = 3y avg, g = min(ROE x (1 - 3y avg payout), terminal g)
justified_pb.meaning: P/B a single-stage residual-income model supports: (ROE - g) / (Ke - g) with sustainable ROE and growth.

pb_to_justified_pb.name: P/B / justified P/B
pb_to_justified_pb.meaning: Market P/B relative to what returns justify: above 1 = paying for more than current ROE supports.

band.rationale: Paying 50%+ above the P/B that sustainable ROE justifies needs ROE to rise; at or below 1.0x the price is covered by current returns.

data_notes.text: Source file ICICIBANK.xlsx; sha256 36102589824d81ad...; Screener template version 2.1. Only the 'Data Sheet' is read (display sheets are formulas without cached values).
Units: Rs crore. Share counts in crore (Screener 'Adjusted Equity Shares in Cr'); prices in Rs.
Data Sheet has 2 formula cell(s) without cached values (e.g. 'Number of shares'); recomputed where needed.
Blank line items are treated as zero (Screener leaves zero items blank; the P&L and balance-sheet identities hold on that basis). Blank price or share count = missing.
Financial company: other income is core (fees, treasury), so no exceptional-item estimate is made.

Net profit differs from PBT - tax in 10 of 10 years (latest -3,466): minority interest (negative) and share of associates/JVs (positive) sit between PBT and net profit, so the export is consolidated and net profit is the owners' share. Equity excludes minority interest (Screener includes NCI in Other Liabilities); ROIC/ROCE capital therefore omits NCI unless data/manual supplies minority_interest.

Bank-like mapping: Sales = interest earned (NBFC: revenue from operations); Interest = interest expended; Borrowings = deposits + borrowings (NBFC: borrowings); Other Assets include advances/loans; Other Expenses include provisions & contingencies (credit costs are not separable in the export); CFO is driven by loan/deposit flows and is not an earnings-quality signal.

Capex is not in the export. Proxy = change in net block + change in CWIP + depreciation (includes acquired fixed assets and Ind AS 116 right-of-use additions; impairments and disposals understate it). FCF = CFO - capex proxy.

Per-share history is split/bonus/rights-adjusted by Screener (adjusted shares / reported shares: FY17 x1.10). EPS, BVPS, DPS and FY-end prices all use the adjusted basis, so ratios are unaffected; per-share levels are in today's share units (a unit look-ahead, not an information look-ahead).
Current price and market cap are as of the export date, which the file does not record (latest quarter in file: 2026-09-30).
10 quarters from 2024-06-30 to 2026-09-30 (Q1FY25-Q2FY27). Quarterly profit is as reported (no exceptional-item estimate).
